capacity.category: Lakeshore University Medical Center: Immediate by air
capacity.notes: Open. Immediate patients only, by Air 7, 22 minutes. One patient per flight. Level I trauma center, burn center, neurosurgery, pediatric trauma.

fields.notes:
18:00, by phone from LCEMS Medical Director Dr. Samir Anand to the Medical Group Supervisor: "Use county START, with JumpSTART for any children. Do NOT switch to SALT tonight unless I call you back. Have Triage say it on TAC 3 so every mutual aid crew hears it."

18:01, LRMC MEDCOM on MED 1, reading the capacity board: "LRMC Open, 21 of 24 ED beds, 3 trauma bays, MEDCOM site. St. Brendan's Limited intake, CT down, no head injuries. Pinecrest Memorial Open, 5 ED beds. Lakeshore Open, Immediate patients by Air 7 only, 22 minutes. Give me your counts as soon as you have them."

All statuses above are read from the LRMC MEDCOM capacity board at 18:01. No patients assigned yet. No counts given to MEDCOM yet.

instructorNote: This sets the triage method and the starting hospital picture. Players should still check the board, not just trust it. Watch for three things: MED has Triage announce START/JumpSTART on LARK TAC 3 and sets a triage target of about 18:15. The coordinator reads the incident, method, counts and expected arrivals to MEDCOM. MEDCOM restates the limit of 3 Immediate patients to LRMC in the first 30 minutes, calls the coalition coordinator for the Level 2 MCI and asks every hospital to post its status now.
